title: English Practice Quiz 0968
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A strong password should generally be ___.
options: long, unique and difficult to guess
questions.explanation: Long, unique passwords are harder to guess and limit damage from reuse.

questions.question: Two-factor authentication adds ___.
options: a second username for every person
questions.explanation: It requires another proof of identity beyond the password.

questions.question: A phishing message often tries to ___.
options: trick people into revealing sensitive information
questions.explanation: Phishing uses deceptive messages to steal information or access.

questions.question: A browser is software used to ___.
questions.explanation: A web browser opens and displays websites.

questions.question: Cloud storage allows files to be ___.
options: stored on remote servers and accessed online
questions.explanation: Cloud storage keeps data on remote systems accessible over a network.

questions.question: A software update may include ___.
options: a guaranteed increase in battery size
free mobile data from every provider
questions.explanation: Updates can fix vulnerabilities and improve software.

questions.question: A spreadsheet is especially useful for ___.
questions.explanation: Spreadsheets organise information in cells and can calculate results.

questions.question: Before opening an unexpected email attachment, you should ___.
options: verify the sender and check whether it is safe
questions.explanation: Unexpected attachments can contain malicious content.

questions.question: A QR code can store information that a phone camera can ___.
options: convert into a paper document automatically
questions.explanation: A camera and suitable software can read the encoded information.

questions.question: A backup is a separate copy of data kept to ___.
options: help restore information if the original is lost
questions.explanation: Backups help recover data after loss or damage.
